description: Leaves a note on a thread for the people who work it: shown on the thread screen beside the messages, marked as internal, and in "notes" of get_conversation. It never reaches the correspondent: it is not sent, not quoted in a reply and not part of the mail. It is where the context goes when you hand a thread to a colleague, what you found, what was agreed, why you stopped. It does not change the status of the thread nor its place in the list. It is signed with the name of the person this connection acts for, when it acts for one. Up to 10000 characters. To leave the same note on several threads, give conversation_id the list of their ids, in ONE call rather than one call per thread: the answer then lists in "results" the outcome of each thread in the order given ("ok", with its "result" or its "error") and counts "succeeded" and "failed". Each thread passes exactly the checks it would alone, so one refused or out of reach ("not found") leaves the others done, and the call is an error only when none succeeded.

body.description: The text of the note, plain text, up to 10000 characters.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it, or a list of up to 50 ids to do the same to every one of them in a single call.

name: add_note
title: Leave an internal note on a thread
